concepts.text: Fixed-tilt monocrystalline PV array: 6 x 400 W panels (~2.4 kWp) in 2 strings, tilt = latitude facing equator, on ground/roof rack behind cold room
concepts.author: Surya — Off-Grid Solar Power Specialist

concepts.text: Battery plus controller cabinet: 48 V 100 Ah LiFePO4 battery (~5 kWh) with 60 A MPPT charge controller, ventilated shaded cabinet beside cold room — assumed_constraint: sized for one full night plus cloudy-day margin
concepts.author: Surya — Off-Grid Solar Power Specialist

concepts.text: Low-loss Direct Current wiring: panels in series pairs to raise voltage and cut current, short thick copper cables in conduit, fuses and disconnect at cabinet
concepts.author: Surya — Off-Grid Solar Power Specialist

concepts.text: 100 mm Polyurethane sandwich-panel cold box: 2 x 2 x 2.2 m inside, cam-lock panels, sealed door with gaskets, shaded outside — assumed_constraint: 100 mm thickness for 30 K hot ambient
concepts.author: Lena — Refrigeration and Thermal Insulation Engineer

concepts.text: Direct Current vapor-compression chiller: 48 V Direct Current compressor with Coefficient of Performance about 2.5, wall evaporator plus shaded condenser, thermostat 4-10 C
concepts.author: Lena — Refrigeration and Thermal Insulation Engineer

concepts.text: Uniform low-velocity airflow: raised slatted floor, stacked vented crates with gaps, small fan blowing over evaporator for even temperature

concepts.text: Stackable vented food-grade crates 600x400x300 mm, about 60 crates each holding 15-20 kg to total 1 tonne, cross-stacked with vent gaps

concepts.text: Two low side racks with centre aisle: crates stacked 3 high on slatted platforms, 100 mm wall gap and floor lift for air and cleaning, single 900 mm hinged door — assumed_constraint: racking fits 2x2 m box with human reach under 1.8 m
concepts.author: Farah — Post-Harvest and Cooperative Operations Specialist

concepts.text: Washable hygienic use routine: smooth metal liner walls, coved washable floor, first-in-first-out crate rotation labels, daily mop and weekly crate wash at shaded wash point

evidence.code_or_query:
from pint import UnitRegistry
Q_=UnitRegistry().Quantity
k=0.022 # W/mK PU foam
d=0.10 # m
U=k/d
A=2*(2*2+2*2.2+2*2.2)
dT=33
Qcond=U*A*dT
Qresp=1000*0.05 # 50 mW/kg
Qfan=60
Qinf=80
Qsteady=Qcond+Qresp+Qfan+Qinf
E_pull=(Q_(1000,'kg')*Q_(3.6,'kJ/kg/K')*Q_(25,'K')).to('kWh')
P_pull=(E_pull/Q_(24,'h')).to('W')
COP=2.5
E_day_elec=((Q_(Qsteady,'W')*Q_(24,'h')).to('kWh')/COP)
print(f"U={U:.3f} W/m2K A={A:.1f} m2 Qcond={Qcond:.0f} W Qsteady={Qsteady:.0f} W E_pull={E_pull:.1f} P_pull={P_pull:.0f} E_day_elec={E_day_elec:.2f}")
